state_legend.INDEXED: present in a list; not a measurement
state_legend.STAGED: signed and awaiting promotion into chain/root
state_legend.MEASURED: a run with a result behind it
state_legend.UNMEASURED: declared slot or placeholder with no run
state_legend.VALID: verifier state for a signature that checks; never a grade
